verses.text: Jacob settled in Canaan, the same land where his father had lived as a traveler. 🏠

Here’s Jacob’s family story. Joseph was seventeen, out tending the flock with his brothers—the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought their father a bad report about his brothers. 🐑
Israel loved Joseph more than all his other children because Joseph was born to him in his old age. He made him a special robe with many colors. 🧥
His brothers saw that their father loved Joseph more than them, and they hated him. They couldn’t even speak to him peacefully. 😠
Joseph had a dream and told his brothers. That made them hate him even more. 🌙
He said, “Please listen to the dream I had: 👂
“We were tying up bundles of grain out in the field. Then my bundle stood up straight, and your bundles gathered around and bowed to mine.” 🌾
His brothers shot back, “So you really think you’ll rule us? You think you’ll be boss over us?” His dreams and words only made them hate him more. 😤
Joseph had another dream and told his brothers, “Look, I dreamed again: the sun, the moon, and eleven stars bowed down to me.” 🌞
He told his father too. His father rebuked him: “What kind of dream is that? Are your mother, your brothers, and I really going to bow down to the ground in front of you?” 🤨
His brothers were jealous, but his father kept the matter in mind. 💭
One day his brothers went to Shechem to pasture their father’s flock. 🐑
Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers tending the flock in Shechem? Come, I’m sending you to them.” Joseph said, “I’m here.” 🫡
His father said, “Go check whether your brothers and the flock are doing well, then come bring me word.” He sent Joseph from Hebron Valley, and Joseph arrived in Shechem. 🧭
A man found Joseph wandering around in the field and asked, “What are you looking for?” 🔎
Joseph said, “I’m looking for my brothers. Please tell me where they’re pasturing the flock.” 🐑
The man said, “They’ve moved on. I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers and found them in Dothan. 🧭
They spotted Joseph from far away. Before he could even reach them, they started plotting to kill him. ⚠️
They said to each other, “Look, here comes that dreamer.” 😒
“Come on, let’s kill him, dump him in one of these pits, and tell everyone a wild animal got him. Then we’ll see what becomes of those dreams.” 😨
Reuben heard them and stepped in to rescue Joseph. “Let’s not take his life,” he said. 🛑
Reuben told them, “Don’t spill blood. Throw him into that pit out in the wilderness, but don’t lay a hand on him.” He planned to rescue Joseph and return him to their father. 🤫
When Joseph reached his brothers, they stripped off his special robe—the colorful one he was wearing. 🧥
They grabbed him and threw him into the pit. It was empty, with no water in it. 🕳️
Then they sat down to eat. Looking up, they saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead. Their camels carried spices, balm, and myrrh on the way to Egypt. 🐪
Judah said to his brothers, “What do we gain by killing our brother and hiding his blood?” 🤔
“Come on, let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites. We won’t have to kill him—after all, he’s our brother, our own flesh.” His brothers agreed. 💰
When the Midianite merchants came by, they pulled Joseph up from the pit and sold him to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants took Joseph to Egypt. ⛓️
Reuben came back to the pit, but Joseph wasn’t there. He tore his clothes in grief. 😢
He went back to his brothers and cried, “The boy is gone! What am I supposed to do now?” 😭
They took Joseph’s robe, killed a male goat, and dipped the robe in its blood. 🩸
Then they sent the colorful robe to their father with this message: “We found this. Take a good look and tell us whether it’s your son’s robe.” 🧥
Jacob recognized it. “It’s my son’s robe! A wild animal must have torn Joseph apart!” 🐾
Jacob tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and mourned his son for many days. 🖤
All his sons and daughters tried to comfort him, but he refused. “I’ll go down to Sheol grieving for my son.” His father kept weeping for him. 🕯️
Meanwhile, the Midianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Potiphar, one of Pharaoh’s officials and captain of the guard. 🇪🇬⛓️
